business.name: Paje Farm Houses
business.address: Paje Road, Paje · East Coast · Zanzibar, Tanzania

dishes.name: Samaki wa Kupaka na Wali wa Nazi
dishes.alt: Samaki wa Kupaka with coconut rice
desc: Samaki wa Kupaka is the signature dish at Paje Farm Houses: grilled fish in a coconut-tamarind sauce, served with coconut rice, kachumbari and lime.
It is a classic Swahili coastal plate — order it as part of a restaurant reservation in Paje, on the East Coast of Zanzibar.

faqs.q: What is samaki wa kupaka?
faqs.a: Samaki wa kupaka is grilled fish coated in a tamarind-coconut sauce. At Paje Farm Houses it comes with coconut rice, kachumbari and lime.

faqs.q: How do I order Samaki wa Kupaka in Paje?
faqs.a: Send a restaurant reservation enquiry to Paje Farm Houses at info@pajefarmhouses.com or +255 778 621 086, and mention the dish.

dishes.name: Pilau ya Zanzibar na Kuku wa Kienyeji
desc: Pilau ya Zanzibar with kuku wa kienyeji is fragrant island pilau rice served with slow-cooked local chicken, kachumbari and pilipili on the side.
It is one of the most filling Swahili plates at Paje Farm Houses in Paje, Zanzibar.
facts: Zanzibar pilau rice with local chicken
Kachumbari and pilipili on the side

faqs.q: What is Zanzibar pilau?
faqs.a: Zanzibar pilau is spiced rice cooked with island spices. At Paje Farm Houses it is served with slow-cooked local chicken (kuku wa kienyeji).

faqs.q: Is the chicken local?
faqs.a: Yes. The dish is prepared with kuku wa kienyeji — local chicken — and the team confirms availability when you enquire.

dishes.name: Nyama Pori ya Siku
desc: Nyama Pori ya Siku is the day's available wildlife meat, grilled and served with ugali or wali, greens and kachumbari at Paje Farm Houses.
Available meats change daily, so the team confirms types, preparation and availability before your visit to Paje.
facts: The day's available grilled wildlife meat
Ugali or wali, greens and kachumbari
Changes daily — confirmed by the team
Mention nyama pori in your reservation enquiry

faqs.q: What is nyama pori?
faqs.a: Nyama pori is wildlife (game) meat, grilled. At Paje Farm Houses the available types change daily.

faqs.q: How do I know which meats are available?
faqs.a: Mention nyama pori in your enquiry to info@pajefarmhouses.com or +255 778 621 086, and the team confirms the day's meats, dishes and dietary information.

dishes.name: Maharage ya Nazi na Chapati
desc: Maharage ya Nazi are red beans simmered in creamy coconut milk, served with chapati or coconut rice and steamed greens.
It is the heartiest vegetarian plate at Paje Farm Houses in Paje, Zanzibar.
facts: Chapati or coconut rice and steamed greens

faqs.q: Is there vegetarian food in Paje?
faqs.a: Yes. Paje Farm Houses serves vegetarian plates such as Maharage ya Nazi with chapati or coconut rice.

faqs.q: Is Maharage ya Nazi vegan?
faqs.a: Share dietary requirements or allergies with the team in your enquiry and they will confirm the preparation.

dishes.name: Mboga za Kisiwani na Ndizi za Kuchoma
desc: Mboga za Kisiwani na Ndizi za Kuchoma combines seasonal island vegetables with grilled plantain, coconut beans and kachumbari.
It is a fresh vegetarian option at Paje Farm Houses, following the day's harvest and season.
facts: Seasonal island vegetables with grilled plantain

faqs.q: What vegetables are served?
faqs.a: Seasonal island vegetables that follow the day's harvest, with grilled plantain, coconut beans and kachumbari.

faqs.q: Is the menu the same every day?
faqs.a: No. Dishes follow the day and season — the team confirms today's menu when you enquire.

dishes.name: Juice ya Miwa na Tangawizi
desc: Juice ya Miwa na Tangawizi is fresh-pressed sugarcane with ginger and lime, served over ice at Paje Farm Houses.
Ask also for madafu baridi — chilled young coconut — to go with your meal in Paje.
facts: Fresh-pressed sugarcane, ginger and lime over ice
Ask with your meal or reservation enquiry

faqs.q: What fresh drinks are served?
faqs.a: Fresh-pressed sugarcane juice with ginger and lime, plus madafu baridi on request.

faqs.q: Is madafu available?
faqs.a: Ask the team — madafu baridi is served on request alongside meals.

dishes.name: Chai ya Viungo vya Zanzibar
desc: Chai ya Viungo is Zanzibari spiced tea brewed with cinnamon, cardamom, cloves and ginger at Paje Farm Houses.
It is served plain or with milk — a warm finish after a Swahili meal in Paje.
facts: Black tea with cinnamon, cardamom, cloves and ginger
Ask with your meal or reservation enquiry

faqs.q: What is chai ya viungo?
faqs.a: Zanzibari spiced tea brewed with cinnamon, cardamom, cloves and ginger, served plain or with milk.

faqs.q: When is it served?
faqs.a: As a hot drink with meals at Paje Farm Houses — ask the team.

experiences.name: Spice Farm Visit
experiences.alt: Spice plants growing at the farm
desc: A spice farm visit at Paje Farm Houses lets you explore the plants behind Zanzibar's flavours, paired with a Swahili restaurant experience.
Visit times, plants to explore and any costs are confirmed by the team before your visit to Paje.
facts: Guided walk through the farm's spice plants
Confirmed by the team before your visit
Send a spice farm visit enquiry

faqs.q: Can I visit the spice farm?
faqs.a: Yes. Enquire using the form and the team confirms visit times, plants to explore and any costs before your visit.

faqs.q: Can I combine it with lunch?
faqs.a: Yes. Pair the spice farm visit with a Swahili restaurant experience at Paje Farm Houses.

experiences.name: Swahili Cooking Class
experiences.tagline: Cook it. Taste it. Take it home.
desc: The Swahili cooking class at Paje Farm Houses is a 2-hour hands-on session: cook pilau, samaki wa kupaka and chapati with the team, then eat together.
You leave with recipes to try at home — and it costs $30 per person.
facts: Pilau, samaki wa kupaka and chapati
Send a cooking class enquiry; times and group sizes confirmed by the team

faqs.q: How much is the Swahili cooking class?
faqs.a: The 2-hour class is $30 per person. Times and group sizes are confirmed with the team.

faqs.q: What will I learn to cook?
faqs.a: Pilau, samaki wa kupaka and chapati — then you eat together and take recipes home.

experiences.name: Plant Your Zanzibar Memory
experiences.alt: Planting and tending a young tree
experiences.tagline: Buy a plant. Make it yours.
desc: Plant Your Zanzibar Memory lets you choose, buy and plant your own tree at Paje Farm Houses — a living connection to the island after your holiday.
Care for it yourself on return visits, arrange paid care, and follow photo updates from home.
facts: Buy and plant your own tree kept at the farm
Self care on visits, or paid farm-team care

faqs.q: Does the plant belong to me?
faqs.a: Yes. The programme is designed for you to buy and own a plant kept at Paje Farm Houses, with ownership and care terms confirmed before purchase.

faqs.q: What happens when I return home?
faqs.a: Arrange paid maintenance and follow progress through photos and care updates.

experiences.name: Organic Farming Volunteering
experiences.alt: Volunteer watering seedlings in the organic farm
experiences.tagline: Give your time. Grow your connection.
desc: The organic farming volunteer programme at Paje Farm Houses is hands-on time in the shamba: planting, watering and organic growing with the farm team.
Beginners are welcome. Share your dates, duration, experience and interests — the team agrees activities with you.
facts: Hands-on organic farming: planting, watering, growing
Activities, dates and requirements agreed with the team
An enquiry does not confirm a placement

faqs.q: Do I need farming experience?
faqs.a: No. Beginners are welcome — share your experience level and the team agrees suitable activities.

faqs.q: Does volunteering include meals or stays?
faqs.a: Meals, accommodation and terms are agreed separately with the team.
